articles.summary: Fourth -quarter net income attributable to MPC of $1.5 billion, or $5.12 per diluted share, adjusted net income of $1.2 billion, or $4.07 per diluted share Full-year refining utilization of 94 percent and margin capture of 105 percent, demonstrating strong operational and commercial performance Cash from operations of $8.3 billion enabled peer-leading capital returns of $4.5 billion in 2025 MPLX's growing distribution is expected to more than fund MPC's 2026 dividend and standalone capital; a so
articles.title: Marathon Petroleum Corp. Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results
